summary: @servicetitan/contentful-proxy preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` (`execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`). `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle obfuscated with a shuffled numeric string-array plus a rotating character-map decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9` over `n7gIxM`), with URL-shaped fragments reconstructed at runtime rather than appearing as readable strings. `setup.mjs` itself is machine-obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (hex-mangled identifiers such as `_0x488df8`, per-function lookup dispatch objects like `_0x19328d.YCZJE`). The package is published under the `@servicetitan` npm scope with a repository URL pointing at github.com/servicetitan/contentful-proxy and advertises Contentful React helpers, a purpose that has no need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated install driver. Installing this package causes an alternate runtime not visible to Node-based tooling to execute an opaque payload on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
